1:1.web: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah over against Suf, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
1:1.kjv: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

1:2.web: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.
1:2.kjv: (There are eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh-barnea.)

1:3.web: In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel, according to all that Yahweh had given him in commandment to them;
1:3.kjv: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the LORD had given him in commandment unto them;

1:4.web: after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.
1:4.kjv: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:

1:5.web: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,
1:5.kjv: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,

1:6.web: “Yahweh our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.
1:6.kjv: The LORD our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:

1:7.web: Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites, and to all the places near there, in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the South, by the seashore, in the land of the Canaanites, and in Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.
1:7.kjv: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.

1:8.web: Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them and to their offspring after them.’”
1:8.kjv: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.

1:9.web: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.
1:9.kjv: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:

1:10.web: Yahweh your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.
1:10.kjv: The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.

1:11.web: Yahweh, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are, and bless you, as he has promised you!
1:11.kjv: (The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)

1:12.web: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?
1:12.kjv: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?

1:13.web: Take wise men of understanding and well known according to your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”
1:13.kjv: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.

1:14.web: You answered me, and said, “The thing which you have spoken is good to do.”
1:14.kjv: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.

1:15.web: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, and captains of fifties, and captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.
1:15.kjv: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.

1:16.web: I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers, and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.
1:16.kjv: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.

1:17.web: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.”
1:17.kjv: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God’s: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.

1:18.web: I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.
1:18.kjv: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.

1:19.web: We traveled from Horeb, and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as Yahweh our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.
1:19.kjv: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.

1:20.web: I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which Yahweh our God gives to us.
1:20.kjv: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give unto us.

1:21.web: Behold, Yahweh your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has spoken to you. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.”
1:21.kjv: Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.

1:22.web: You came near to me, everyone of you, and said, “Let us send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring us word again of the way by which we must go up, and the cities to which we shall come.”
1:22.kjv: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.

1:23.web: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve men of you, one man for every tribe.
1:23.kjv: and the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:

1:24.web: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.
1:24.kjv: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.

1:25.web: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down to us, and brought us word again, and said, “It is a good land which Yahweh our God gives to us.”
1:25.kjv: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.

1:26.web: Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh your God.
1:26.kjv: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:

1:27.web: You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because Yahweh hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
1:27.kjv: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.

1:28.web: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”
1:28.kjv: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.

1:29.web: Then I said to you, “Don’t dread, neither be afraid of them.
1:29.kjv: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.

1:30.web: Yahweh your God who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,
1:30.kjv: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;

1:31.web: and in the wilderness, where you have seen how that Yahweh your God bore you, as a man does bear his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”
1:31.kjv: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.

1:32.web: Yet in this thing you didn’t believe Yahweh your God,
1:32.kjv: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God,

1:33.web: who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.
1:33.kjv: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.

1:34.web: Yahweh heard the voice of your words, and was angry, and swore, saying,
1:34.kjv: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,

1:35.web: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land, which I swore to give to your fathers,
1:35.kjv: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,

1:36.web: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him, and to his children, because he has wholly followed Yahweh.”
1:36.kjv: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.

1:37.web: Also Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.
1:37.kjv: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.

1:38.web: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
1:38.kjv: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

1:39.web: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, and your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.
1:39.kjv: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.

1:40.web: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
1:40.kjv: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

1:41.web: Then you answered and said to me, “We have sinned against Yahweh, we will go up and fight, according to all that Yahweh our God commanded us.” Every man of you put on his weapons of war, and presumed to go up into the hill country.
1:41.kjv: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.

1:42.web: Yahweh said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you; lest you be struck before your enemies.’”
1:42.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.

1:43.web: So I spoke to you, and you didn’t listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.
1:43.kjv: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and went presumptuously up into the hill.

1:44.web: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.
1:44.kjv: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.

1:45.web: You returned and wept before Yahweh; but Yahweh didn’t listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you.
1:45.kjv: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.

1:46.web: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.
1:46.kjv: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.

2:1.web: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as Yahweh spoke to me; and we encircled Mount Seir many days.
2:1.kjv: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.

2:2.kjv: And the LORD spake unto me, saying,

2:3.web: “You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward.
2:3.kjv: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.

2:4.web: Command the people, saying, ‘You are to pass through the border of your brothers the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.
2:4.kjv: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:

2:5.web: Don’t contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on; because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession.
2:5.kjv: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a footbreadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.

2:6.web: You shall purchase food from them for money, that you may eat. You shall also buy water from them for money, that you may drink.’”
2:6.kjv: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.

2:7.web: For Yahweh your God has blessed you in all the work of your hand. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, Yahweh your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.
2:7.kjv: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.

2:8.web: So we passed by from our brothers the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
2:8.kjv: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Ezion-gaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

2:9.web: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t bother Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession; because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession.”
2:9.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.

2:10.web: (The Emim lived therein before, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakim.
2:10.kjv: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;

2:11.web: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.
2:11.kjv: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.

2:12.web: The Horites also lived in Seir before, but the children of Esau succeeded them. They destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place; as Israel did to the land of his possession, which Yahweh gave to them.)
2:12.kjv: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.

2:13.web: “Now rise up, and cross over the brook Zered.” We went over the brook Zered.
2:13.kjv: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.

2:14.web: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea, until we had come over the brook Zered, were thirty-eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp, as Yahweh swore to them.
2:14.kjv: And the space in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the LORD sware unto them.

2:15.web: Moreover Yahweh’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.
2:15.kjv: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.

2:16.web: So, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
2:16.kjv: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

2:17.kjv: That the LORD spake unto me, saying,

2:18.web: “You are to pass over Ar, the border of Moab, today.
2:18.kjv: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:

2:19.web: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon, don’t bother them, nor contend with them; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession; because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.”
2:19.kjv: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.

2:20.web: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim: Rephaim lived there before; but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,
2:20.kjv: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;

2:21.web: a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but Yahweh destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place;
2:21.kjv: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:

2:22.web: as he did for the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place even to this day:
2:22.kjv: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:

2:23.web: and the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and lived in their place.)
2:23.kjv: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)

2:24.web: “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon: behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
2:24.kjv: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.

2:25.web: Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of you.”
2:25.kjv: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.

2:26.web: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
2:26.kjv: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

bsb: we will stay on the main road.
2:27.web: “Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway, I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.
2:27.kjv: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.

2:28.web: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,
2:28.kjv: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;

2:29.web: as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me; until I pass over the Jordan into the land which Yahweh our God gives us.”
2:29.kjv: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.

2:30.web: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him; for Yahweh your God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as it is today.
2:30.kjv: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.

2:31.web: Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.”
2:31.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.

2:32.web: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.
2:32.kjv: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

2:33.web: Yahweh our God delivered him up before us; and we struck him, his sons, and all his people.
2:33.kjv: And the LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.

2:34.web: We took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We left no one remaining.
2:34.kjv: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:

bsb: We carried off for ourselves only
2:35.web: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.
2:35.kjv: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.

2:36.web: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. Yahweh our God delivered up all before us.
2:36.kjv: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto us:

2:37.web: Only to the land of the children of Ammon you didn’t come near; all the banks of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and wherever Yahweh our God forbade us.
2:37.kjv: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the LORD our God forbad us.

3:1.web: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
3:1.kjv: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

3:2.web: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people, and his land, into your hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”
3:2.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

3:3.web: So Yahweh our God delivered into our hand Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him until no one was left to him remaining.
3:3.kjv: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.

3:4.web: We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them; sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
3:4.kjv: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

3:5.web: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars; besides a great many villages without walls.
3:5.kjv: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.

3:6.web: We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.
3:6.kjv: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.

3:7.web: But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves.
3:7.kjv: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.

3:8.web: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.
3:8.kjv: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;

3:9.web: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)
3:9.kjv: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)

3:10.web: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
3:10.kjv: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

3:11.web: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)
3:11.kjv: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.

3:12.web: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead, and its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites:
3:12.kjv: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.

3:13.web: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.
3:13.kjv: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.

3:14.web: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)
3:14.kjv: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashan-havoth-jair, unto this day.

3:15.kjv: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.

3:16.web: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
3:16.kjv: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

3:17.web: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.
3:17.kjv: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdoth-pisgah eastward.

3:18.web: I commanded you at that time, saying, “Yahweh your God has given you this land to possess it. You shall pass over armed before your brothers the children of Israel, all the men of valor.
3:18.kjv: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are meet for the war.

3:19.web: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,
3:19.kjv: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;

3:20.web: until Yahweh gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which Yahweh your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”
3:20.kjv: Until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.

3:21.web: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to these two kings. So shall Yahweh do to all the kingdoms where you go over.
3:21.kjv: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the LORD do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.

3:22.web: You shall not fear them; for Yahweh your God himself fights for you.”
3:22.kjv: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.

3:23.web: I begged Yahweh at that time, saying,
3:23.kjv: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,

3:24.web: “Lord Yahweh, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?
3:24.kjv: O Lord GOD, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?

3:25.web: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”
3:25.kjv: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.

3:26.web: But Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, and didn’t listen to me. Yahweh said to me, “Let this satisfy you. Speak no more to me of this matter.
3:26.kjv: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.

3:27.web: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.
3:27.kjv: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

3:28.web: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”
3:28.kjv: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.

3:29.web: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.
3:29.kjv: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.

4:1.web: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances, which I teach you, to do them; that you may live, and go in and possess the land which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, gives you.
4:1.kjv: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.

4:2.web: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you.
4:2.kjv: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.

4:3.web: Your eyes have seen what Yahweh did because of Baal Peor; for all the men who followed Baal Peor, Yahweh your God has destroyed them from among you.
4:3.kjv: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal-peor: for all the men that followed Baal-peor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.

4:4.web: But you who were faithful to Yahweh your God are all alive today.
4:4.kjv: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.

bsb: so that you may follow them
4:5.web: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Yahweh my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.
4:5.kjv: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.

4:6.web: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
4:6.kjv: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

4:7.web: For what great nation is there, that has a god so near to them, as Yahweh our God is whenever we call on him?
4:7.kjv: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for?

4:8.web: What great nation is there, that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law, which I set before you today?
4:8.kjv: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?

bsb: and so that they do not
4:9.web: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children;
4:9.kjv: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons’ sons;

4:10.web: the day that you stood before Yahweh your God in Horeb, when Yahweh said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”
4:10.kjv: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.

4:11.web: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.
4:11.kjv: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.

4:12.web: Yahweh spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.
4:12.kjv: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.

4:13.web: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.
4:13.kjv: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.

4:14.web: Yahweh commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.
4:14.kjv: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.

4:15.web: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that Yahweh spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,
4:15.kjv: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:

4:16.web: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
4:16.kjv: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

4:17.web: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,
4:17.kjv: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,

4:18.web: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;
4:18.kjv: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:

4:19.web: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which Yahweh your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.
4:19.kjv: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.

4:20.web: But Yahweh has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.
4:20.kjv: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.

4:21.web: Furthermore Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land, which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance;
4:21.kjv: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:

4:22.web: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan; but you shall go over, and possess that good land.
4:22.kjv: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.

4:23.web: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which Yahweh your God has forbidden you.
4:23.kjv: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.

4:24.web: For Yahweh your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.
4:24.kjv: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.

bsb: and you have been in the land
4:25.web: When you shall father children, and children’s children, and you shall have been long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and shall do that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight, to provoke him to anger;
4:25.kjv: When thou shalt beget children, and children’s children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:

4:26.web: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.
4:26.kjv: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.

bsb: and only a few of you
4:27.web: Yahweh will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations, where Yahweh will lead you away.
4:27.kjv: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.

4:28.web: There you shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
4:28.kjv: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

4:29.web: But from there you shall seek Yahweh your God, and you shall find him, when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.
4:29.kjv: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

4:30.web: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to Yahweh your God, and listen to his voice.
4:30.kjv: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;

bsb: He swore to them by oath.
4:31.web: For Yahweh your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you, neither destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.
4:31.kjv: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.

4:32.web: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as this great thing is, or has been heard like it?
4:32.kjv: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?

4:33.web: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
4:33.kjv: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?

4:34.web: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Yahweh your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
4:34.kjv: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

4:35.web: It was shown to you so that you might know that Yahweh is God. There is no one else besides him.
4:35.kjv: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.

4:36.web: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.
4:36.kjv: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.

4:37.web: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;
4:37.kjv: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;

4:38.web: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.
4:38.kjv: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.

4:39.web: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that Yahweh himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.
4:39.kjv: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the LORD he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.

4:40.web: You shall keep his statutes, and his commandments, which I command you today, that it may go well with you, and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land, which Yahweh your God gives you, forever.
4:40.kjv: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.

4:41.web: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;
4:41.kjv: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

4:42.web: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unawares, and didn’t hate him in time past; and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:
4:42.kjv: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:

4:43.web: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.
4:43.kjv: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.

4:44.web: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.
4:44.kjv: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:

4:45.web: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which Moses spoke to the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt,
4:45.kjv: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,

bsb: while they were in the valley
4:46.web: beyond the Jordan, in the valley over against Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck, when they came out of Egypt.
4:46.kjv: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:

bsb: of the land belonging to Sihon
4:47.web: They took his land in possession, and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;
4:47.kjv: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

4:48.web: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Sion (also called Hermon),
4:48.kjv: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,

4:49.web: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.
4:49.kjv: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.

5:1.web: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”
5:1.kjv: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.

5:2.web: Yahweh our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
5:2.kjv: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

5:3.web: Yahweh didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.
5:3.kjv: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.

5:4.web: Yahweh spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,
5:4.kjv: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,

5:5.web: (I stood between Yahweh and you at that time, to show you Yahweh’s word: for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain;) saying,
5:5.kjv: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,

5:6.web: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
5:6.kjv: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

5:7.web: “You shall have no other gods before me.
5:7.kjv: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.

5:8.web: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself, any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
5:8.kjv: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:

5:9.web: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them; for I, Yahweh, your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me;
5:9.kjv: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,

5:10.web: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
5:10.kjv: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.

5:11.web: “You shall not take the name of Yahweh your God in vain: for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who takes his name in vain.
5:11.kjv: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

5:12.web: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as Yahweh your God commanded you.
5:12.kjv: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.

5:13.web: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;
5:13.kjv: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:

5:14.web: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God, in which you shall not do any work, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.
5:14.kjv: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.

5:15.web: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore Yahweh your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
5:15.kjv: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.

5:16.web: “Honor your father and your mother, as Yahweh your God commanded you; that your days may be long, and that it may go well with you, in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
5:16.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

5:20.web: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
5:20.kjv: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.

5:21.web: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”
5:21.kjv: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour’s wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour’s house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour’s.

5:22.web: Yahweh spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.
5:22.kjv: These words the LORD spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.

5:23.web: When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
5:23.kjv: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

5:24.web: and you said, “Behold, Yahweh our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.
5:24.kjv: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.

5:25.web: Now therefore why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear Yahweh our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.
5:25.kjv: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.

5:26.web: For who is there of all flesh, that has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?
5:26.kjv: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?

5:27.web: Go near, and hear all that Yahweh our God shall say, and tell us all that Yahweh our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”
5:27.kjv: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.

5:28.web: Yahweh heard the voice of your words, when you spoke to me; and Yahweh said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.
5:28.kjv: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.

5:29.web: Oh that there were such a heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children forever!
5:29.kjv: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!

5:30.kjv: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.

5:31.web: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandment, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.”
5:31.kjv: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.

5:32.web: You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.
5:32.kjv: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

5:33.web: You shall walk in all the way which Yahweh your God has commanded you, that you may live, and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.
5:33.kjv: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.

6:1.web: Now this is the commandment, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it;
6:1.kjv: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:

6:2.web: that you might fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you; you, and your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.
6:2.kjv: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.

6:3.web: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.
6:3.kjv: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.

6:4.web: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.
6:4.kjv: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:

6:5.web: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
6:5.kjv: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

6:6.web: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
6:6.kjv: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:

bsb: And you shall teach them diligently
6:7.web: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
6:7.kjv: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

6:8.web: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
6:8.kjv: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.

6:9.web: You shall write them on the door posts of your house, and on your gates.
6:9.kjv: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.

6:10.web: It shall be, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities, which you didn’t build,
6:10.kjv: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,

6:11.web: and houses full of all good things, which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out, which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees, which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;
6:11.kjv: And houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;

6:12.web: then beware lest you forget Yahweh, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
6:12.kjv: Then beware lest thou forget the LORD, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

6:13.web: You shall fear Yahweh your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.
6:13.kjv: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.

6:14.web: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you;
6:14.kjv: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;

6:15.web: for Yahweh your God among you is a jealous God; lest the anger of Yahweh your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.
6:15.kjv: (For the LORD thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.

6:16.web: You shall not tempt Yahweh your God, as you tempted him in Massah.
6:16.kjv: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.

6:17.web: You shall diligently keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.
6:17.kjv: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.

6:18.web: You shall do that which is right and good in Yahweh’s sight; that it may be well with you, and that you may go in and possess the good land which Yahweh swore to your fathers,
6:18.kjv: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers,

6:19.web: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as Yahweh has spoken.
6:19.kjv: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.

bsb: is the meaning of the decrees
6:20.web: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh our God has commanded you mean?”
6:20.kjv: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?

6:21.web: then you shall tell your son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;
6:21.kjv: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:

6:22.web: and Yahweh showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;
6:22.kjv: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:

6:23.web: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.
6:23.kjv: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.

bsb: that we may always be prosperous
as we are to this day.
6:24.web: Yahweh commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahweh our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.
6:24.kjv: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.

6:25.web: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all this commandment before Yahweh our God, as he has commanded us.”
6:25.kjv: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded us.

7:1.web: When Yahweh your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, seven nations greater and mightier than you;
7:1.kjv: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;

bsb: then you must devote them to complete destruction.
7:2.web: and when Yahweh your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them; then you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.
7:2.kjv: And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:

7:3.web: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.
7:3.kjv: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.

7:4.web: For he will turn away your son from following me, that they may serve other gods. So Yahweh’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.
7:4.kjv: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.

bsb: you are to do to them:
7:5.web: But you shall deal with them like this. You shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their engraved images with fire.
7:5.kjv: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.

7:6.web: For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God. Yahweh your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.
7:6.kjv: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.

7:7.web: Yahweh didn’t set his love on you, nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples:
7:7.kjv: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:

7:8.web: but because Yahweh loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers, Yahweh has brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
7:8.kjv: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

7:9.web: Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with them who love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations,
7:9.kjv: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;

7:10.web: and repays those who hate him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slack to him who hates him. He will repay him to his face.
7:10.kjv: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.

7:11.web: You shall therefore keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which I command you today, to do them.
7:11.kjv: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.

7:12.web: It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances, and keep and do them, that Yahweh your God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to your fathers.
7:12.kjv: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:

7:13.web: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your livestock and the young of your flock, in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you.
7:13.kjv: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

7:14.web: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.
7:14.kjv: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.

7:15.web: Yahweh will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you, but will lay them on all those who hate you.
7:15.kjv: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.

7:16.web: You shall consume all the peoples whom Yahweh your God shall deliver to you. Your eye shall not pity them. You shall not serve their gods; for that would be a snare to you.
7:16.kjv: And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.

7:17.web: If you shall say in your heart, “These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?”
7:17.kjv: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?

7:18.web: you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what Yahweh your God did to Pharaoh, and to all Egypt:
7:18.kjv: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;

7:19.web: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which Yahweh your God brought you out. So shall Yahweh your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.
7:19.kjv: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.

7:20.web: Moreover Yahweh your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.
7:20.kjv: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.

7:21.web: You shall not be scared of them; for Yahweh your God is among you, a great and awesome God.
7:21.kjv: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.

7:22.web: Yahweh your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.
7:22.kjv: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.

7:23.web: But Yahweh your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are destroyed.
7:23.kjv: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.

7:24.web: He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall make their name perish from under the sky. No one will be able to stand before you, until you have destroyed them.
7:24.kjv: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.

7:25.web: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to Yahweh your God.
7:25.kjv: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it is an abomination to the LORD thy God.

bsb: will be set apart for destruction.
7:26.web: You shall not bring an abomination into your house, and become a devoted thing like it. You shall utterly detest it, and you shall utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.
7:26.kjv: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.

8:1.web: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers.
8:1.kjv: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.

8:2.web: You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to prove you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments, or not.
8:2.kjv: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.

8:3.web: He humbled you, and allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know; that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of Yahweh’s mouth.
8:3.kjv: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.

8:4.web: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.
8:4.kjv: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.

8:5.web: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so Yahweh your God disciplines you.
8:5.kjv: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.

8:6.web: You shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
8:6.kjv: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

8:7.web: For Yahweh your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;
8:7.kjv: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;

8:8.web: a land of wheat and barley, and vines and fig trees and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;
8:8.kjv: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;

8:9.web: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarceness, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.
8:9.kjv: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.

8:10.web: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless Yahweh your God for the good land which he has given you.
8:10.kjv: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.

8:11.web: Beware lest you forget Yahweh your God, in not keeping his commandments, and his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;
8:11.kjv: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:

8:12.web: lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses, and lived in them;
8:12.kjv: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;
